features.text: CalendarGet: Get calendar file from storage. (GET /email/Calendar)
CalendarSave: Save iCalendar (PUT /email/Calendar)
CalendarGetList: Get iCalendar list from storage folder. (GET /email/Calendar/list)
CalendarGetAsAlternate: Get iCalendar from storage as AlternateView (GET /email/Calendar/as-alternate)
CalendarAsAlternate: Convert iCalendar to AlternateView (PUT /email/Calendar/as-alternate)
CalendarAsFile: Converts calendar model to specified format and returns as file. (PUT /email/Calendar/as-file)
CalendarGetAsFile: Converts calendar document from storage to specified format and returns as file. (GET /email/Calendar/as-file)
CalendarAsMapi: Converts CalendarDto to MapiCalendarDto. (PUT /email/Calendar/as-mapi)
CalendarConvert: Converts calendar document to specified format and returns as file. (PUT /email/Calendar/convert)
CalendarFromFile: Converts calendar document to a model representation. (PUT /email/Calendar/from-file)
ContactGet: Get contact document from storage. (GET /email/Contact)
ContactSave: Save contact to storage. (PUT /email/Contact)
ContactGetList: Get contact list from storage folder. (GET /email/Contact/list)
ContactAsFile: Converts contact model to specified format and returns as file (PUT /email/Contact/as-file)
ContactGetAsFile: Converts contact document from storage to specified format and returns as file (GET /email/Contact/as-file)
ContactAsMapi: Converts ContactDto to MapiContactDto. (PUT /email/Contact/as-mapi)
ContactFromFile: Converts contact document to a model representation (PUT /email/Contact/from-file)
ContactConvert: Converts contact document to specified format and returns as file (PUT /email/Contact/convert)
EmailGet: Get email document from storage. (GET /email)
EmailSave: Save email document to storage. (PUT /email)
EmailGetList: Get email list from storage folder. (GET /email/list)
EmailAsFile: Converts Email model to a specified format and returns as a file. (PUT /email/as-file)
EmailGetAsFile: Converts email document from storage to specified format and returns as file (GET /email/as-file)
EmailAsMapi: Converts EmailDto to MapiMessageDto. (PUT /email/as-mapi)
EmailFromFile: Converts email document to a model representation (PUT /email/from-file)
EmailConvert: Converts email document to specified format and returns as file (PUT /email/convert)
MapiCalendarGet: Get MAPI calendar document. (GET /email/MapiCalendar)
MapiCalendarSave: Save MAPI Calendar to storage. (PUT /email/MapiCalendar)
MapiCalendarAsFile: Converts MAPI calendar model to specified format and returns as file. (PUT /email/MapiCalendar/as-file)
MapiCalendarAsCalendarDto: Converts MAPI calendar model to CalendarDto model. (PUT /email/MapiCalendar/as-calendar-dto)
MapiCalendarFromFile: Converts calendar file to a MAPI model representation. (PUT /email/MapiCalendar/from-file)
MapiContactGet: Get MAPI contact document. (GET /email/MapiContact)
MapiContactSave: Save MAPI Contact to storage. (PUT /email/MapiContact)
MapiContactAsFile: Converts MAPI contact model to specified format and returns as file. (PUT /email/MapiContact/as-file)
MapiContactAsContactDto: Converts MAPI contact model to ContactDto model. (PUT /email/MapiContact/as-contact-dto)
MapiContactFromFile: Converts contact file to a MAPI model representation. (PUT /email/MapiContact/from-file)
MapiMessageGet: Get MAPI message document. (GET /email/MapiMessage)
MapiMessageSave: Save MAPI message to storage. (PUT /email/MapiMessage)
MapiMessageAsFile: Converts MAPI message model to specified format and returns as file. (PUT /email/MapiMessage/as-file)
MapiMessageAsEmailDto: Converts MAPI message model to EmailDto model (PUT /email/MapiMessage/as-email-dto)
MapiMessageFromFile: Converts email file to a MAPI model representation (PUT /email/MapiMessage/from-file)
DisposableEmailIsDisposable: Check email address is disposable (GET /email/disposable/is-disposable)

EmailConfigDiscover: Discover email accounts by email address.
Does not validate discovered accounts. (GET /email/config/discover)

EmailConfigDiscoverPassword: Discover email accounts by email address.
Validates discovered accounts using login and password. (PUT /email/config/discover/password)

EmailConfigDiscoverOauth: Discover email accounts by email address.
Validates discovered accounts using OAuth 2.0. (PUT /email/config/discover/oauth)
ClientAccountSave: Create/update email client account file (*.account) with credentials (PUT /email/client/account)
ClientAccountGet: Get email client account from storage. (GET /email/client/account)

ClientAccountSaveMulti: Create email client multi account file (*.multi.account).
Will respond error if file extension is not ".multi.account". (PUT /email/client/account/multi)

ClientAccountGetMulti: Get email client multi account file (*.multi.account).
Will respond error if file extension is not ".multi.account". (GET /email/client/account/multi)
ClientMessageSend: Send an email specified by model in request. (POST /email/client/message)
ClientMessageFetch: Fetch message from email account (GET /email/client/message)
ClientMessageDelete: Delete message. (DELETE /email/client/message)
ClientMessageAppend: Add email message to specified folder in email account. (POST /email/client/message/append)
ClientMessageList: Get messages from folder, filtered by query (GET /email/client/message/list)
ClientMessageSetIsRead: Mark message as read or unread. (PUT /email/client/message/set-is-read)

ClientThreadGetList: Get message threads from folder.
All messages are partly fetched (without email body and some other fields). (GET /email/client/thread/list)

ClientThreadGetMessages: Get messages from thread by id. All messages are fully fetched.
For accounts with CacheFile only cached messages will be returned. (GET /email/client/thread/messages)
ClientThreadDelete: Delete thread by id. All messages from thread will also be deleted. (DELETE /email/client/thread)
ClientThreadSetIsRead: Mark all messages in thread as read or unread. (PUT /email/client/thread/set-is-read)
AiBcrParseStorage: Parse images from storage to vCard files (PUT /email/AiBcr/parse-storage)
AiBcrParse: Parse images to vCard document models (PUT /email/AiBcr/parse)
AiNameParse: Parse name to components. (GET /email/AiName/parse)
AiNameGenderizeParsed: Detect person's gender from parsed name. (PUT /email/AiName/genderize-parsed)
AiNameGenderize: Detect person's gender from name string. (GET /email/AiName/genderize)
AiNameComplete: The call proposes k most probable names for given starting characters. (GET /email/AiName/complete)

AiNameFormatParsed: Formats a person's parsed name in correct case and name order using options for formatting
instructions. (PUT /email/AiName/format-parsed)

AiNameFormat: Formats a person's name in correct case and name order using options for formatting
instructions. (GET /email/AiName/format)

AiNameExpandParsed: Expands a person's parsed name into a list of possible alternatives using options for expanding
instructions. (PUT /email/AiName/expand-parsed)

AiNameExpand: Expands a person's name into a list of possible alternatives using options for expanding
instructions. (GET /email/AiName/expand)
AiNameMatchParsed: Compare people's parsed names and attributes. Uses options for comparing instructions. (PUT /email/AiName/match-parsed)
AiNameMatch: Compare people's names. Uses options for comparing instructions. (GET /email/AiName/match)
AiNameParseEmailAddress: Parse person's name out of an email address. (GET /email/AiName/parse-email-address)
